sentences.japanese: 空を飛んでいる鳥を撃つ事は難しい。
sentences.english: It is difficult to shoot a bird flying in the air.

sentences.japanese: 我々は敵に向かって大砲を撃った。
sentences.english: We fired guns at the enemy.

sentences.japanese: 何百羽とキジを撃った。
sentences.english: We shot pheasants by the hundred.

sentences.japanese: 何故私は彼らを撃つ、教えてくれ、彼らが何をしたのだ？
sentences.english: Why am I shooting these guys, tell me, what have they done?
